tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated for grants under this subpart $10,000,000 for fiscal year 2003.

tree.heading: Availability of funds
tree.text: Amounts appropriated pursuant to the authorization under this section shall remain available, without fiscal year limitation, until expended.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15453 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: pilot program for testing of equipment and technology
